summary: The branch was rebased onto a base that builds app-host paths with `appPaths.under`. The template changes now use it for the instance directories in `slot()` and `instances()`, after `app_name` has checked the extension ID and instance key. All other logic matches the round 3 version, so the round 1 fixes are still in place. All temp test runs pass, every changed line is covered or has an exemption I accept, and no P0 or P1 findings remain.
